newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rexel shares up on acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Rexel shares up on acquisitions.

text.p: Shares in electrical equipment retailer Rexel rose sharply on Monday following the announcement on Friday that it had made three acquisitions.

Rexel, a subsidiary of Pinault-Printemps-Redoute, said it had acquired ABB's wholesale electrical equipment business, which had 400 million francs of annual sales. It said it had also bought Boehm & Hennes, with 50 million francs in sales, and Britain's Sunbridge, with 70 million francs in sales.
Its stock was up 2.94 percent at 1,750 francs at 1353 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was down 0.42 percent.
A trader said the acquisitions were expected to contribute positively to Rexel's results.

Rexel said on Friday that it had also signed an agreement to sell Omnitech Sertronique, with 107 million francs in sales, to Britain's Eurodis Electron Plc. The sale should close on April 17. It did not disclose any of the terms.
